B1/nitrate/Q1.decision_note: inclusive limits applied to the unrounded recovery; display is not used for the decision

B1/nitrate/S1.decision_note: strict > on the unrounded RSD, evaluated exactly; the six-decimal display cannot express a near-tie

intent: QC recovery is exactly 79.9999999%, one part in 1e7 below the inclusive 80% limit, so the unrounded decision is FAIL while six-decimal display rounds to 80.000000. A consumer re-deriving the decision from displayed values sees an apparent contradiction; this reports an unrounded/display gap, not a wrong decision.
